snippet.title: ToMyX – Official Demo Trailer | Bullet-Hell Visual Novel | Based on Real Relationships
snippet.description:
🎮 Download the game demo here → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458330/ToMyX_Demo
🛒 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4444610/ToMyX

What if your real-life relationships became bullet-hell boss fights?

The demo of ToMyX is now available. Wishlist the full game on Steam and support the project.

ToMyX is a surreal bullet hell visual novel game inspired by Danganronpa where you confront my real-life exes inside a bizarre game show.

Each relationship becomes a playable trial.
Each duel reflects a memory.
Each choice pushes you closer to the Final Judgment.

#ToMyX #IndieGame #BulletHell #VisualNovel #SteamGame

🎮 Download the game demo here → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458330/ToMyX_Demo
🛒 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4444610/ToMyX

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🎮 Descarga la demo del juego aquí → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458330/ToMyX_Demo
🛒 Añádelo a tu lista de deseados en Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4444610/ToMyX

¿Y si tus ex se convirtieran en tus peores enemigas?

La demo de ToMyX ya está disponible. Añade el juego completo a tu lista de deseados en Steam y apoya el proyecto.

ToMyX es un juego surrealista que mezcla bullet hell y visual novel, inspirado en Danganronpa, donde te enfrentas a mis exnovias reales dentro de un extraño programa de televisión.

Cada relación se convierte en un juicio jugable.
Cada duelo refleja un recuerdo.
Cada decisión te acerca al Juicio Final.
